{"code": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_DOWN

debt = Decimal("10492.96")
weekly_payment = Decimal("1311.62")
monthly_payment = Decimal("1311.62")

start_date = datetime.now(ZoneInfo("America/New_York")).date()

schedule = []
current_date = start_date

for i in range(5):
    schedule.append({
        "amount": float(weekly_payment),
        "currency": "USD",
        "scheduled_at": current_date.isoformat()
    })
    current_date = current_date + timedelta(weeks=1)

for i in range(3):
    schedule.append({
        "amount": float(monthly_payment),
        "currency": "USD",
        "scheduled_at": current_date.isoformat()
    })
    if i < 2:
        next_month = current_date.replace(day=1) + timedelta(days=32)
        current_date = next_month.replace(day=current_date.day)

total_to_pay = weekly_payment * 5 + monthly_payment * 3
schedule_sum = sum(Decimal(str(p["amount"])) for p in schedule)

months_valid = all(
    (schedule[i+1]["scheduled_at"][:7] == schedule[i]["scheduled_at"][:7]) or
    (datetime.fromisoformat(schedule[i+1]["scheduled_at"]).month - datetime.fromisoformat(schedule[i]["scheduled_at"]).month == 1) or
    (datetime.fromisoformat(schedule[i+1]["scheduled_at"]).month == 1 and datetime.fromisoformat(schedule[i]["scheduled_at"]).month == 12)
    for i in range(len(schedule) - 1)
)

valid = schedule_sum == total_to_pay and months_valid
print(f"schedule_entries={len(schedule)},sum={schedule_sum},expected={total_to_pay},valid={valid}")"}
